title: Arthur Hayes exits crypto trading positions as analysts track $26 million in sales
summary: Arthur Hayes has exited Maelstrom's directional crypto positions, and on-chain analysts are tracking about $26 million in token sales. In an Oct. 24 statement, Hayes said he had taken profits on Ethereum (ETH), Ethena (ENA), Uniswap (UNI), and other cryptocurrencies, citing mounting macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty. title: A16z is the latest VC giant to widen bets beyond crypto and into AI and emerging tech
summary: The venture investor behind early bets on Coinbase, Solana and Uniswap said is broadening its focus, joining other crypto investment firms looking beyond blockchain to artificial intelligence and tech themes.

title: Uniswap’s aggregator hooks go live on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain
summary: Uniswap Labs has launched aggregator hooks, allowing Uniswap v4 to route trades through liquidity held on external platforms.
